Definition: a Merarite (collectively), or decendants of Merari
BiblicalUsage: Merariy names the Merarites, the family of Merari among the Levites. Numbers 26:57 counts them after their families, of Merari, the family of the Merarites, alongside the Gershonites and the Kohathites.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the census kept every family, because every family had its burden to carry for the tabernacle.
